notes.title: Crypt Door Fix + Sound Tweaks
notes.notes: This patch fixes a small bug where the main entrance door stayed open after entering the underground crypts. We also tweaked the volume on a few ambient sounds. No changes to gameplay. Sorry for the hassle—and thanks for bearing with us!

notes.title: 🔧 **Minor UI Update Now Live**
notes.notes:
We've just pushed a small UI fix that improves menu text, menu alignment, and images UI. This was something we missed before launch—thanks for your patience!

No gameplay changes.

Cheers,  
Crypt Robbery, Dad Games Team
